blocks.text: If necessary, Ada Tours may substitute the listed hotel with another in the same category. The order of excursions may change while the tour programme remains the same. Ada Tours is not responsible for hotel breakfasts missed when early checkout is required for an early flight or excursion.

On arrival in La Paz, you’ll be met at the airport and taken to your hotel. Early check-in is not included.

The city tour starts at 14:00. The first stop is Mercado Rodríguez, a food market where you can see local produce and learn about local food, daily habits and how people shop in the city.

The tour continues at the Witches’ Market, where vendors sell traditional remedies and items used in rituals and offerings to Pachamama, or Mother Earth. After the market, you’ll visit the Basilica of San Francisco, one of Bolivia’s best-known churches in the Mestizo Baroque style, and then Plaza Murillo. The Presidential Palace, the Congress building and the cathedral stand around the square.

The day ends with a ride on the city’s cable car. From above, you can see the Andes, the densely built hillsides and the streets and neighbourhoods of La Paz.

Included: one night at La Casona Hotel Boutique or a hotel in the same category, private transfer, a bilingual English- and Spanish-speaking guide, cable car tickets, and transfer from the airport to the hotel. Meals are not included.
